title: Punchcard Artifact

{{Infobox/Accessory |rarity=e |rift_time = +30s |rift_transferrable = no |auctionable = no |tradeable = no |donatable = no |id=PUNCHCARD_ARTIFACT }} The '''Punchcard Artifact''' is an {{Epic}} [[Accessory]]. == Obtaining == The '''Punchcard Artifact''' can be bid on at {{zone|Barrier Street}}. The top {{Green|25}} bidders win the item. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Accessory |rarity = epic |rift_time = 30 |item_ability_name = Punch in! |item_ability_activation = Left Click |item_ability_description = Punch another player while this is in your inventory to both regain {{Stat|Rift Time|+25}}.
{{Dark Gray|Usable once per player per rift visit up to 20 players.}} }} The '''Punchcard Artifact''' allows the player to punch other players to regain {{Statname|rift time|+25}}. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- |Punched someone |{{Dialogue|&5&lPUNCHCARD!&e You punched &7&e and both regained &a+25ф Rift Time&e!}} |- |Punched by someone |{{Dialogue|&5&lPUNCHED!&e You were punched by &7&e and both regained &a+25ф Rift Time&e!}} |- |Punched 20 players in a session |{{Dialogue|&c&lUH OH!&c You reached the limit of 20 players you can punch in one session!}} |- |Punched the same player after rejoining a session |{{Dialogue|&c&lAWKWARD!&c This player has already been punched by you... somehow!}} |} == Trivia == *Punching is a feature in Hypixel Lobbies, allowing players to hit staff members, making them fly in the air. *It has the same texture as the 9F Operator Chip. *While you can only punch 20 players per rift visit, there is seemingly no limit to how many players can punch you. **In theory, this would allow for infinite {{Statname|Rift Time|}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2023/May 4|[[File:Punchcard Artifact.png|26px]] Added '''Punchcard Artifact'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.19|[[File:Punchcard Artifact.png|26px]] Added '''Punchcard Artifact'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Shen's Auction}} {{Nav/Accessories}}
